connections.note: Every tranche page lists the piece numbers transferred; the final June 2013 tranche is DEFE 24/2448-2465 and 2623-2629.

desc: Between May 2008 and June 2013 the Ministry of Defence transferred its UFO holdings to The National Archives at Kew in a sequenced public release programme, published tranche by tranche on a dedicated nationalarchives.gov.uk/ufos site with a highlights guide written for each tranche by Dr David Clarke and accompanying videocasts and podcasts. The identified tranches and coverage are: October 2008 (DEFE 24/1926-1930 onwards, covering 1986-1992); March 2009 (DEFE 24/1938 and DEFE 31/176-181, covering 1987-1993); August 2009 (DEFE 24/1948, 1959-1965, 1970-1976, 2086, covering 1981-1996, including Rendlesham material); February 2010 (Air Secretariat sighting reports 1996-1999); August 2010 (eighteen files DEFE 24/1973-2045, covering 1995-2003); August 2011 (twenty-six DEFE 24 files plus DEFE 31/182-188, covering 1985-2007); July 2012 (twenty-five files including DEFE 31/189-194, covering 1965-2008, described by the archive as showing 'the role of the UFO Desk Officers, what they really thought of alien visitors, their ideas to harness alien technology as a weapon, and their briefings to Tony Blair on UFO policy'); and the final tranche of June 2013 (DEFE 24/2448-2465 and DEFE 24/2623-2629), covering late 2007 to November 2009 and the closure of the desk. The archive's landing page carried Winston Churchill's July 1952 minute as its epigraph: 'What does all this stuff about flying saucers amount to? What can it mean? What is the truth?' (PREM 11/855).

timeline.label: The National Archives UFO release programme begins
timeline.text: The first of ten tranches of MoD UFO files is published at nationalarchives.gov.uk/ufos with a highlights guide by David Clarke. The programme runs to June 2013 and covers DEFE 24 and DEFE 31.
